familyTheme: Finite-horizon quadratic control rollouts across manufacturing, robotics, thermal, and energy balancing contexts

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Roll Line Step-Recovery Control Summary
derivedTasks.goal: Compute the first control action and one-step prediction for a roll-line linear model using backward Riccati recursion.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task requires correct finite-horizon backward recursion and gain extraction under an MPC-style linear model.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Gimbal Stabilization Sequence
derivedTasks.goal: Generate a clipped control sequence for a gimbal linear model over a fixed horizon and report state snapshots in CSV.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers finite-horizon gain scheduling to a robotics stabilization rollout with saturation.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Two-Zone HVAC Dispatch
derivedTasks.goal: Plan a short-horizon control dispatch that drives zone temperatures toward a target operating point.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task uses finite-horizon dynamic programming on a shifted-state formulation for thermal regulation.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Battery Balancing Action Pack
derivedTasks.goal: Produce an action pack with early controls, terminal state, and quadratic score for a balancing model.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers finite-horizon recursion to a multi-state balancing system and asks for quantitative rollout scoring.
